title: What does this print? (at least one six)
statement:
What does this program print?

```python
n = [$n]
p = 1 - (5/6)**n
print(round(p, 3))
```

[______]{a}

feedback.message: That adds $1/6$ once per roll. The program computes $1-(5/6)^n$ instead.

hints: The program computes the chance of at least one six in n rolls.
Subtract it from 1 and round to 3 decimals.
solution: $(5/6)^{[$n]}$ is the chance of no six in [$n] rolls, so the program prints $1-(5/6)^{[$n]}$ rounded to 3 decimals.
